user_decision: Supplied portrait is the desired approximate makeup appearance/strength; not approval of existing outputs.
visual_target: Warm rose-bronze eyelids with blended depth
Defined lash line and full-looking lashes
scope: One isolated Soft Glam prototype on four reused development portraits
implementation: Source parser contours for layered warm eyelids and lash-line accents
Brow darkening restricted to existing brow labels, not new shape
Outward cheek blush, small localized highlights and source-highlight-driven lip gloss
Supersampled procedural lash strokes; source eye interiors/nose/mouth/nonface restored

technical.protection_definition: All source labels except skin1, eyebrows6/7, lips11/12

findings: Lash strokes look drawn-on/evenly spaced and can sit above real lash line
Warm palette is closer to reference direction but complete finish still inadequate
Lip edges/color can look flat/painted; reference studio finish is not reproduced

reference_handling: Qualitative guide; no identity/complexion transfer, reference redistribution or training use.
next: Validate eye/brow/lip anatomical alignment first; precise face landmark model is a candidate, not an adopted or proven fix. Then one appearance-focused revision rather than ten-style batch.
caveat: Landmark coordinates support placement; they do not generate realistic cosmetics or prove a reference match.

alignment_preflight.conclusion: Potential next component only; no new capability or placement accuracy established.
